# Assignment Submission Policy Document ID: DOC-003 Last Updated: 2026-10-01 Data Status: SAMPLE ACADEMY DATA — NOT OFFICIAL ## 1. Assignment Instructions Students must read the instructions provided with each assignment before starting their work. An assignment may specify: - Required tasks and learning objectives - Accepted file formats - Submission deadline - Evaluation criteria - Required references or documentation - Whether resubmission is allowed Assignment-specific instructions take precedence over general formatting examples when they explicitly define a requirement. ## 2. Submission Format Unless an assignment specifies otherwise, the sample academy accepts the following formats: - PDF for written reports. - IPYNB for Jupyter notebooks. - PY for standalone Python scripts. - ZIP for a project containing multiple required files. Students should use clear file names that include the assignment name and their student identifier. Example: student123_python_assignment.ipynb Before submission, students should verify that: - The file opens correctly. - Required sections and outputs are included. - The submitted file belongs to the correct assignment. - No unnecessary temporary files or credentials are included. A submission is considered recorded only when the platform confirms that the file was received. Students should keep the submission confirmation for their records. # Attendance Policy Document ID: DOC-002 Last Updated: 2026-10-01 Data Status: SAMPLE ACADEMY DATA — NOT OFFICIAL ## 1. Attendance Requirements Students enrolled in sample academy courses are expected to attend scheduled sessions and participate in learning activities. For this fictional academy, students must attend at least 80% of the scheduled sessions to qualify for the standard course-completion certificate. The attendance percentage is calculated as: Attendance Percentage = (Sessions Attended / Total Scheduled Sessions) * 100 Example: A student attends 14 out of 16 sessions. Attendance Percentage = (14 / 16) * 100 = 87.5% The student satisfies the sample attendance requirement because 87.5% is greater than 80%. ## 2. Late Arrival A student is considered late when arriving more than 10 minutes after the scheduled session start time. For this sample policy, three late arrivals are counted as one absence for attendance calculations. Students should notify the instructor if they expect to arrive late. Instructors may record the actual arrival time. ## 3. Absence Procedure Students who cannot attend a session should notify the academy support team before the

absence for attendance calculations. Students should notify the instructor if they expect to arrive late. Instructors may record the actual arrival time. ## 3. Absence Procedure Students who cannot attend a session should notify the academy support team before the session whenever possible. The notification should include: - Student name or academy student ID - Course name - Session date - Reason for absence, if the student wishes to provide it Submitting an absence notification does not automatically convert an absence into an attended session. Students who experience an emergency should contact the support team to ask whether an exception can be reviewed. ## 4. Course Completion Under this sample policy, students must meet all of the following conditions to qualify for the standard course-completion certificate: - Attend at least 80% of scheduled sessions. - Submit all mandatory assignments. - Complete the required final project or assessment, when applicable. - Meet any additional completion requirements explicitly stated in the relevant course document. Meeting the attendance requirement alone does not guarantee a certificate. ## 5. Attendance Records and Disputes Students should

Complete the required final project or assessment, when applicable. - Meet any additional completion requirements explicitly stated in the relevant course document. Meeting the attendance requirement alone does not guarantee a certificate. ## 5. Attendance Records and Disputes Students should review their attendance records regularly. If a student believes an attendance entry is incorrect, they should contact the academy support team and provide the course name, session date, and a description of the discrepancy. The support team should review the available records before confirming any correction. ## 6. Frequently Asked Attendance Questions ### Does an absence notification count as attendance? No. Sending a notification does not automatically count as attending the session. ### Can a student with 75% attendance receive the standard certificate? Not under the default sample requirement of 80%. The student may contact support to ask whether an exception process exists, but no exception is guaranteed. ### Does attending every session guarantee course completion? No. Mandatory assignments and other stated course requirements must also be completed. ## Document Notes All attendance rules in this document are fictional sample
